scenario.summary: Attackers exploit 'php2shell' unauthenticated RCE vulnerabilities in PHP versions 5.4 through 8.1 via crafted HTTP requests to gain initial access. This exploitation is being leveraged by ransomware affiliates like INC and The Gentlemen to execute malicious payloads, including encryptors and administrative tools.

hunt.name: PHP2Shell RCE and Ransomware Execution
hunt.description: This phased hunt identifies internet-facing hosts running vulnerable, end-of-life PHP versions (5.4 through 8.1) and investigates signs of the php2shell RCE. The first phase looks for suspicious HTTP requests and unusual child processes spawned by the PHP interpreter. The second phase follows these leads to identify the deployment of specific ransomware payloads mentioned in the Talos research and evidence of mass file encryption. The hunt concludes by routing suspicious hosts for immediate isolation and analyst review.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, package_name, package_version, install_path FROM hb_software_inventory WHERE (LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%php%' OR LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%wordpress%' OR LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%drupal%' OR LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%magento%' OR LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%shopware%' OR LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%woocommerce%') AND (package_version LIKE '5.%' OR package_version LIKE '6.%' OR package_version LIKE '7.%' OR package_version LIKE '8.0%' OR package_version LIKE '8.1%')
config.description: Scope the estate to hosts running PHP versions 5.4 through 8.1 which are susceptible to PHP2Shell.
config.expected_signal: A list of hosts and their PHP versions. Zero rows means no vulnerable versions are recorded in the inventory.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, process_cmd_line, parent_process_name, user_name, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND LOWER(parent_process_name) LIKE '%php%' AND (instr(',' || '{{interpreter_names}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_original_file_name) || ',') > 0 OR instr(',' || '{{interpreter_names}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_name) || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, COUNT(DISTINCT file_path) AS unique_files, MIN(time) AS first_seen, MAX(time) AS last_seen FROM hb_file_activity WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND activity_id IN (1, 3, 5) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, process_name HAVING unique_files > 100
config.description: Identify processes performing high-volume file modifications, indicative of encryption.
config.expected_signal: A process modifying over 100 files on a single host. If that process matches the payload query, impact is confirmed.
